latest.headline: scagliox01 Triumphs in Croatia
latest.paragraph: In the fourth round of Season 5 in Croatia, scagliox01 secured a dominant JWRC victory by finishing with a total time of 00:49:39.429. With three stage wins throughout the event, scagliox01 claimed 35 points, finishing ahead of Flinnowaty, who took second place and earned 31 total points. Cefa217 rounded out the podium in third, securing 29 points while performing well on the final stage. Despite recording four stage wins, SubaruNyx finished eleventh overall after penalties, though they still managed to secure maximum points in the Power Stage.
